ignoreRules.reason: Tailwind v4 rounded-full is calc(infinity * 1px), which the browser clamps to 2^25px (33554432). Not a real design-token value.
The rule counts '--' as well as em dashes, so every --token and var(--x) is a false match. This file is token-heavy; verify real em dashes with: rg -o '—' <file> | wc -l.
Inline CSS custom properties (--c-*) trip the '--' false match; there are no real em dashes here.
